LESSON: MINING IN EASTERN AFRICA - SODA ASH IN KENYA - GOLD IN TANZANIA - LIMESTONE IN U

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities in Eastern Africa
Topic 3.6: Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we reclaim areas affected by mining East ern Africa?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify minerals found in Eastern Africa
2. describe the methods of extracting minerals in Eastern Africa
3. explain the effects of smining on the environment in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify minerals found in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can identify minerals found in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the methods of extracting minerals in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the methods of extracting minerals in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. explain the effects of smining on the environment in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the effects of smining on the environment in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U in the examples.
2. Explain Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U.
4. Show that you can: identify minerals found in Eastern Africa

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Draw a map of Eastern Africa and show the location of minerals,
2. Discuss how the minerals are extracted (soda ash in Kenya, gold in Tanzania, limestone in Uganda) and share in class the effects of mining on the environment and make a class presentation,
3. Citizenship: Learners have a responsibility of conserving the environment as they write an essay on the solutions to problems associated with mining.
4. Creativity and Imagination: Learners undertake tasks, draw a map of Eastern Africa and show the location of minerals. Values:
5. Patriotism: Learners serve the community as they write essays on the effects of mining on the environment and possible solutions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify minerals found in Eastern Africa
2. describe the methods of extracting minerals in Eastern Africa
3. explain the effects of smining on the environment in Eastern Africa

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
